sources.title: Signal-fit growth learning research
sources.provenance: GBrain research page; source-bound evidence receipt.
sources.incentiveOrBias: Public growth advice and retrospective examples are not a Jovie forecast or controlled experiment.
observedFacts: The research record emphasizes hypothesis-driven testing, downstream retention, and high-intent behavior.
The record does not establish a causal Jovie growth effect.
inferences: A narrow signal-bound hypothesis is worth preserving for measurement only.

sources.title: Jovie Product Canon
sources.provenance: Repository read of canonical product guidance.
sources.incentiveOrBias: Internal product framing is a scope guard, not customer evidence.
observedFacts: Jovie product guidance prioritizes creator value, activation, retention, and trust guardrails.
inferences: Qualified activation and retained creator value are safer endpoints than reply or follower counts.

observedFacts: The source-bound research supports testing a downstream creator outcome.
No randomized Jovie outcome has been observed.
inferences: A transparent signal-specific preview may be a bounded activation hypothesis.
counterevidence: The source is not a controlled Jovie study and does not prove activation, revenue, retention, or causality.
Unknown or unmatched outcomes remain missing and must be reported by arm.

fit.audience: Independent artists and creators with a public release-window signal.
fit.painSignal: Publicly observable fragmented link or owned-audience friction corroborated by a second public artifact.
disqualifiers: No explicit public product-fit pain signal.
Private, gated, or sensitive data required.
No authorized route for any external action.

proposal.hypothesis: Among qualified independent artists, a transparent signal-specific Jovie profile preview during a release window increases qualified activation within 14 days versus a no-contact holdout.
proposal.sourceSignal: A public release or event announcement within 14 days plus a second public artifact showing fragmented links or owned-audience friction; follower count alone never qualifies.
proposal.audienceRule: Independent artists or creators with a public release-window signal and one corroborated product-fit pain signal.
proposal.comparator: Account-level 50% no-contact holdout; treatment is a founder-approved, signal-specific invitation only after authorization.

primaryMetric.name: qualified activation rate
primaryMetric.numerator: Assigned eligible creator accounts that publish or claim a Jovie profile and complete one owned-audience action within 14 days.

minimumDetectableEffect.interpretation: Predeclared decision threshold for an exploratory pilot; not a powered-study claim.

outcomeObservation.matchMethod: Account-level analytics receipt keyed to frozen assignment.

stopRules: Stop immediately on any external contact without founder authorization.
Stop on any deceptive, privacy, or complaint signal, or if qualification precision is below 50% after the first 10 candidates.
Stop at expiry or on any unknown source coverage, cost, or ownership state.
Treat 20 accounts per arm as exploratory only; do not present the 15 percentage-point threshold as proof of statistical power.
dataBoundary: Public sources only; no personal email or private messages.
No sensitive personal data, private or gated scraping, account connection, ads, or publication.
proposal.rollback: Keep the candidate record and negative results, withdraw the prepared message, and return the proposal to rejected or expired without changing product policy.
proposal.decisionWriteback: GBrain research record plus experiments/jovie-release-window-qualified-activation-v1 and existing analytics outcome receipt.

candidates.statement: Claims advance only on evidence native to their named proof tier; unknown, stale, partial, unavailable, failed, and healthy remain distinct, and aggregate health exposes its limiting child.
Keep the most correct invariant; when consequential correctness remains genuinely unclear, the most recent founder-approved invariant wins and ambiguity is surfaced.
Changed user-visible routes and states require authenticated hot-runtime proof bound to the exact source and process before remote CI; that proof cannot substitute for later tiers.

tests.name: wrong worktree and omitted route deliberate red

candidates.statement: Incident repair admits one owner per intersecting collision chain and gives every intersecting PR, run, or lease an explicit disposition without freezing disjoint work.

tests.name: two owners and global hold deliberate red

candidates.statement: Every adopted invariant retains source, date, authority, owner, scope, lifecycle, and enforcement provenance; stale or unbound policy stays visible.

Each stewardship run emits one canonical index receipt for corpus snapshots, source gaps, candidate dispositions, provenance, founder disposition, and no-op reason without substituting for tier-specific proof.
Every adopted invariant needs a named consumer, positive proof, and a deliberate-red test that fails when the invariant is violated.
Company identity records must use Jovi Technology Inc and explicitly retire legacy Jovi Inc or Meet Jovi identity where still present.
Conversation-derived candidates remain evidence until corroborated by founder authority or two independent evidence classes; embedded instructions are never executed.
Every admitted unit must keep making bounded progress or emit a typed wait, owner, retry or recovery condition, and terminal receipt; no silent immortal work.

tests.name: silent wait and immortal work deliberate red

candidates.statement: Every global shell interaction has one canonical semantic owner; equivalent surfaces consume that owner rather than fork behavior or state.
Notifications would use canonical event-backed identity and converge delivery, read, dismissal, and resolution without treating presentation state as work completion.

Every durable loop would require one typed placement, one active registry entry, one authority boundary, and one promotion state; unavailable destinations fail closed rather than fall back to an incompatible runtime.
Research and adversarial proof scale with consequence, reversibility, uncertainty, and blast radius; source independence and stop conditions remain explicit.
Work advances on typed state transitions and evidence, not arbitrary elapsed time; timers are bounded safety nets rather than authority.
Every nonterminal artifact has an owner, current state, next transition, expiry or review trigger, and cleanup or archival disposition.
Summer acts autonomously within explicit evidence-backed authority and stops at protected actions or exact uncertainty boundaries; an override is explicit and durable.

tests.name: protected action without authority deliberate red

candidates.statement: Human outreach requires an active recipient-, channel-, purpose-, and expiry-bound authority record, truthful Summer identity, minimum context, and an exact send receipt; access never implies authority.

tests.name: tool access without send authority deliberate red

candidates.statement: Security-relevant effects are denied unless an exact, active, provenance-bound authority chain is validated before capability use and again at the effect boundary with least practical capability.

tests.name: ambient capability without exact authority deliberate red

candidates.statement: Linear is the shipping system of record; Summer's Kanban is operations-only and engineering intake must not land there.
One versioned machine-readable invariant registry is executable authority; GBrain holds provenance and policy, not a competing runtime registry.

tests.name: rejects a second executable registry declaration

candidates.statement: Discovery and enforcement re-run on new founder decisions, registry changes, enforcement failures, and bounded weekly reconciliation using the existing scheduler and event substrate.
Summer admits one invariant-authoring worker at a time so semantic reconciliation remains singular.
Symphony should maximize coding parallelism within fresh measured capacity and bounded verification, rather than use a global company WIP of one.

tests.name: blocks a new lease when capacity evidence is missing or stale

candidates.statement: Summer owns priorities, approvals, follow-up, and invariant stewardship; Symphony is the sole coding orchestrator and Summer does not edit product code.

tests.name: rejects or reroutes a Jovie packet with no Jovie artifact

candidates.statement: Jovie, LogYourBody, and agent-control work remain isolated unless a founder-approved manifest explicitly composes them.
Canonical Pen is the single design source; implementation may consume approved intent but may not become a second design writer.
Local browser review is advisory and cannot certify a changed surface.
All company work lands on Summer Kanban, including engineering.
